help.text:
INPUT: (1 required)
  -bucket        string  Name of bucket to check.
  -bucket-file   string  File of bucket names to check.
  -mq                    Connect to RabbitMQ to get buckets. Requires config file key "mq". Default: "false"

OUTPUT:
  -db       Save results to a Postgres database. Requires config file key "db.uri". Default: "false"
  -json     Print logs to stdout in JSON format instead of human-readable. Default: "false"

OPTIONS:
  -enumerate           Enumerate bucket objects (can be time-consuming). Default: "false"
  -provider    string  Object storage provider: aws, custom, digitalocean, dreamhost, gcp, linode, scaleway - custom requires config file. Default: "aws"
  -threads     int     Number of threads to scan with. Default: "4"

DEBUG:
  -verbose     Enable verbose logging. Default: "false"
  -version     Print version Default: "false"

If config file is required these locations will be searched for config.yml: "." "/etc/s3scanner/" "$HOME/.s3scanner/"

--bucket-file.help: File of bucket names to check.

--buckets-file.help: Name of text file containing bucket names to check

--dangerous.help: Include Write and WriteACP permissions checks (potentially destructive)

--db.help: Save results to a Postgres database. Requires config file key "db.uri".

--default-region.help: AWS region to default to (Default: us-west-1)

--dump.help: Dump all found open buckets locally

--endpoint-address-style.help: Address style to use for the endpoint. Default: path

--endpoint-url.help: URL of S3-compliant API. Default: https://s3.amazonaws.com

--file.help: File name of buckets to send to MQ

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--include-closed.help: Include found but closed buckets in the out-file

--json.help: Print logs to stdout in JSON format instead of human-readable.

--list.help: List all found open buckets locally

--mq.help: Connect to RabbitMQ to get buckets. Requires config file key "mq".

--out-file.help: Name of file to save the successfully checked buckets in (Default: buckets.txt)

--queue.help: Name of message queue to publish buckets to

--threads.help: Number of threads to scan with.

-bucket.help: string  Name of bucket to check.

-bucket-file.help: string  File of bucket names to check.

-db.help: Save results to a Postgres database. Requires config file key "db.uri". Default: "false"

-enumerate.help: Enumerate bucket objects (can be time-consuming). Default: "false"

-json.help: Print logs to stdout in JSON format instead of human-readable. Default: "false"

-mq.help: Connect to RabbitMQ to get buckets. Requires config file key "mq". Default: "false"

-provider.help: string  Object storage provider: aws, custom, digitalocean, dreamhost, gcp, linode, scaleway - custom requires config file. Default: "aws"

-threads.help: int     Number of threads to scan with. Default: "4"

buckets.help: Name of text file containing buckets to check
